about: Review checklist for reconstructed DISPLAY geometry (CLAUDE.md: reconstructed display geometry). Script-checked items are updated by tools/airport_map/*; sign-off is Franco's only. Predictions, routing or position inference on this airport stay OFF until every item passes AND signed_off_by is set, and even then they are a separate change.

items.check: Reconstruction (original FAA styling) rendered at the same scale as the FAA PDF: FAA ink covered and extra ink, 1 px tolerance at 300 dpi.
Every NASR runway end within 30 m of the diagram-derived end (display sign-off threshold, Franco D3). Predictions will need a stricter threshold (~10 m), to be set later.
items.prediction_threshold_note: 13 (10.40 m) and 31 (13.68 m) would FAIL a ~10 m prediction threshold. Display only; see geometry_of_record.

items.check: Runway count and end identifiers match NASR and the diagram labels exactly.

result.note: NASR also lists helipad H1; the diagram labels it H1 (checked separately as a held-out point)

items.check: Every diagram taxiway label is matched to an OSM ref, or listed and explained.
items.note: Letter-named taxiways: all matched. Numbers 1-19 are gate lead-ins (Franco, Oct 8), not taxiway names: destination only, never a route element; #14 chart-only. Nothing auto-resolved.

items.check: Hot-spot count and IDs match the diagram's HS labels.
Each ILS HOLD annotation has its dashed hold line found (FAA APDs do not draw every hold position).
No unclassified objects, or each listed one reviewed.
Today is on or before the diagram's effective-to date.

geometry_of_record.decision: Chart-derived (reconstructed) geometry is for DISPLAY only. Any future prediction logic must use NASR runway-end coordinates (and the OSM taxiway network after A3, once reviewed) as the geometry of record, never chart-traced positions. Predictions on KLGA stay OFF regardless until this checklist passes and Franco signs off.
geometry_of_record.reason: Runway ends 13 (10.40 m) and 31 (13.68 m) pass the 30 m display threshold but would fail a ~10 m prediction threshold; the chart offsets/rotates drawn runways by up to ~12 m / 0.32 deg.

sign_off.statement: I, Franco, sign off KLGA for DISPLAY ONLY. Predictions stay off.
sign_off.recheck_when: the chart cycle expires (map view shows CHART CYCLE EXPIRED) or any checklist item changes status
